summary.text: Broden Borg is the Labor candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election, for the seat being vacated by retiring Labor MP Steve McGhie. He is a teacher who grew up in Melton, was brought up by his grandparents and went to Melton Secondary College.

priorities.text: Continuing local projects in schools, accessible health care and roads

sources.title: Melton: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Broden Borg, Candidate for Melton, Victorian Labor

summary.text: Daire Kelly is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. He came to Australia from Ireland more than ten years ago, and his family has been based in the Melton area since then. He works in customer service for an outdoor equipment retailer, serves as a workplace delegate for RAFFWU, the retail and fast food workers' union, and holds university qualifications in applied physics and in sustainable energy engineering.

occupation.text: Customer service worker at an outdoor equipment store

prior_roles.organisation: Retail and Fast Food Workers Union

priorities.text: Better public transport for Melton, including the electrified trains promised years ago and more resources at Melton station
Local health services that keep up with population growth in the outer west
Public ownership and control of the move to renewable energy
Relief from energy bills, which he blames on profit-taking by the big retailers

sources.title: Melton: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Daire Kelly, Victorian Socialists

summary.text: Fiona Adin-James is the Animal Justice Party candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. A crisis counsellor, she has worked in community services since 1990, including disability advocacy, community gardens and programs for older people. She stood for the party in Melton in 2022 and in the federal seat of Hawke in 2025.

priorities.text: Stronger legal protection for wildlife, including nature corridors in planning decisions
Making shade and shelter compulsory for farm animals
Reform of mental health and disability services, led by people with lived experience
Crisis support for women with children

summary.text: Hayden Legro is The West Party's candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. He is a solicitor of about 25 years' standing who owns a legal practice in Melton. He has been involved for over three decades with Reclink Australia, a sport and recreation charity, where he has served as a director and is now a life member.

priorities.text: More infrastructure for Melbourne's western suburbs, which he says have missed out for decades
Honest, transparent state government
Justice and fairness for all, whatever their background
A party that represents only the western suburbs

sources.title: Melton: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Hayden Legro, The West Party

summary.text: Jarrod Bingham is the Liberal candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. A volunteer firefighter who runs a snake-catching business, he has lived in Bacchus Marsh for over 20 years. He has run four times before, each time as an independent: for Melton in the 2018 and 2022 state polls, and for the federal seats of Gorton (2019) and Hawke (2022).

priorities.text: Less crime and safer streets in Melton
Lower cost of living for families
Better transport and less traffic

summary.text: Marlene West is the Family First candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. Raised in Tasmania, she is a registered nurse who completed a nursing degree in 1996 and later a graduate diploma in mental health, and has nursed in Victoria and Queensland. She also holds a Certificate of Ministry from Charis Bible College.

occupation.text: Registered nurse and mental health nurse

priorities.text: Supports Family First's Christian values and wants a greater say in local politics

sources.title: Melton: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Matthew Katselis is One Nation's candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC says he has worked in logistics for about eight years. He ran for One Nation in Hawke, the federal seat that overlaps Melton, in 2025 and took 9.7 per cent of first preferences. One Nation's candidate page could not be read for this profile.

sources.title: Melton: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Veronika Levchenkova is the Greens candidate for Melton at the 2026 Victorian election. She describes herself as a mother of four, a carer for an elderly parent and a community organiser involved in local clubs, environment groups and parents' programs. She stood for the Greens in Coolibah Ward at the 2024 City of Melton election.

priorities.text: Affordable housing and fairer rents
Lower energy bills
Safer communities and protecting the environment
puts families, community and the environment ahead of corporate interests
